calls.title: GrowthBook | HubSpot Implementation Check-In
calls.summary: The team discussed the integration of webinar registration within HubSpot, utilizing Zoom for automated registrations through a newly configured workflow. The design of the landing page was deferred to a future relaunch to enhance efficiency and address other priorities. Clear naming conventions for workflows were established, and the integration confusion between Zoom Events and Webinars was clarified. Automating registration via LinkedIn lead gen forms was identified as an immediate focus to scale lead capture. Upcoming webinars were discussed, targeting Khan Academy in mid-April, with plans for landing page design and increased ad spending on LinkedIn.
calls.keywords: HubSpot integration, Zoom webinar registration, LinkedIn lead gen forms, Workflow automation, Zoom Events vs. Zoom Webinars, Webinar landing page design
